card.line: The Jordan is the main river of the land of Israel, where God opened the water for His people and where Jesus was baptized.

moments.title: Israel Crosses on Dry Ground
moments.text: When the priests carrying the ark touched the Jordan, the flowing water stood still. All Israel crossed on dry ground near Jericho.

moments.title: Twelve Stones from the River
moments.text: The LORD told Joshua to have twelve men, one from each tribe, take stones from the middle of the Jordan. The stones were a memorial of how the waters were cut off.

moments.title: Elisha Takes Up the Cloak
moments.text: After Elijah went up into heaven, Elisha picked up Elijah's cloak and struck the Jordan. The waters parted and he crossed over.

moments.title: Naaman Washes and Is Healed
moments.text: Elisha told Naaman to wash seven times in the Jordan. Naaman did it, and his flesh was restored like that of a little child.

moments.title: Jesus Is Baptized
moments.text: Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to be baptized by John. The Spirit of God came down like a dove, and a voice from heaven called Him God's beloved Son.
